name: Shani
source:
Daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c136573]Zaton[/url] and older sister to [url=https://vndb.org/c136564]Ain[/url]

My pupil, my trainee, and quite possibly, my successor, when I shall be too old to travel the path of the desert. She has been trained by myself and several other masters in Zeta to become a Desert Stalker in her own right, and the time for that to happen is fast approaching.
translation:
Daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c136573]Zaton[/url] and older sister to [url=https://vndb.org/c136564]Ain[/url]

My pupil, my trainee, and quite possibly, my successor, when I shall be too old to travel the path of the desert. She has been trained by myself and several other masters in Zeta to become a Desert Stalker in her own right, and the time for that to happen is fast approaching.
